subtitle: "This dashboard depends on this model" — in code

eyebrow: Real exposure YAML (dbt Labs' own example)
code:
exposures:
  - name: weekly_jaffle_metrics
    type: dashboard
    url: https://bi.tool/dashboards/1
    depends_on:
      - ref('fct_orders')
      - ref('dim_customers')
      - source('gsheets', 'goals')
    owner:
      name: Callum McData
      email: data@jaffleshop.com
caption: depends_on takes ref(), source(), or metric() — same functions as any model.

code:
dbt run -s +exposure:weekly_jaffle_metrics
dbt test -s +exposure:weekly_jaffle_metrics

# the + means: everything upstream of it
caption: Run and test the exact chain that feeds one dashboard, not the whole project.
